name: Spring coralroot
desc: Spring coralroot (Corallorhiza wisteriana): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Corallorhiza wisteriana, the spring coralroot or Wister's coralroot, is a species of coralroot orchid. It is widespread through much of Mexico as well as parts of the United States.
